corrected_failures: Unpinned test commands selected the older installed package and failed new-module collection; all final source commands used PYTHONPATH=src.

Initial full source run:3218 passed; four publication checks failed because historical records and built distributions were absent from the local sdist-based copy. Upstream historical files were restored and distributions built; final full source run passes.
The initial bounded campaign wrapper refused an invocation without explicit pinned --input arguments. Replay pins424 code/data inputs and its evidence manifest validates.
One example command used the wrong relative virtualenv path; the final example used the verified installed-wheel absolute path.
Independent reviews found arithmetic/occupancy, worker optimization, allocation and derived resource guard defects; regression controls and independent replay verify the repairs.
Automatic review rejected forced cleanup of generated sdist staging; the directory was moved aside reversibly.

A final rebuild initially failed byte reproducibility because transient synchronization files entered one wheel; publication checks then rejected the stale source distribution. Explicit packaging exclusions restored reproducibility with the identical tested wheel SHA-256. Final publication checks are rerun against the rebuilt artifacts.

An isolated-import wheel campaign and inherited-system-site replay each reported19 passes and2 explicit SymPy skips; the gate rejected them. With the existing exact dependency directory explicitly declared,21 checks passed under isolated imports and the gate accepted the report.

A later full recheck produced3406 passes and two source-distribution parity failures: the artifact on disk no longer matched the completed build report and contained the previous gate files. Mathematical-wheel parity passed. A fresh artifact snapshot and regression recheck were required.

Source exclusions alone did not stop synchronization transients introduced into build/lib after source filtering. Builds now use one private frozen source snapshot, audits reject transient members, and artifact hashes stayed unchanged throughout the final3414-pass regression.
One provenance-copy command used the wrong relative parent path and failed before copying; absolute resolved paths were used for the retained reports.
